# Gooey section edge: Taffy, a liquid scroll effect between page sections

Stretches on scroll, snaps back with one wobble. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and other AI coding agents.

![Gooey section edge: Taffy, a liquid scroll effect between page sections](demo/preview.jpg)

[Open the demo](demo/index.html) · [Demo prompt](demo/PROMPT.md) · [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) · [References](REFERENCES.md)

## What it does

Rebuilds the 'Taffy' gooey section edge from Louis's motion labs (gooey-sections.html, tab 3): it stretches smoothly while you scroll; let go and it drops, overshoots past flat, comes back and gives one small wobble. The boundary between two page sections acts like a liquid surface driven by scroll speed. Use this skill whenever the user asks for the taffy goo or taffy edge, or wants a scroll-driven section edge that stretches and then snaps back with a single wobble, or for gooey sections tab 3, on a plain HTML page, a Webflow site or a React/Next.js app, even if they only name the feel. It ships a verified 1:1 port of the lab engine, so the result matches the lab exactly.

## Use it

- **Claude Code**: copy this folder to `~/.claude/skills/gooey-section-taffy/` (or run `python3 install.py` from the repository root), then ask in your own words or call `/gooey-section-taffy`.
- **Codex**: copy this folder into your Codex skills directory and ask: "Use $gooey-section-taffy to add the taffy gooey edge between the sections of this page."
- **Other agents**: point the agent at [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) and let it follow the steps.
